guide.description: A classic 808-style drum machine: twelve synthesized voices on a 16-step sequencer.

controls.action: Start the preset beat; press again to stop.
Next pattern, A–D. While playing, it switches at the end of the bar.
Cycle the step for the selected voice: on, accent, off.
Mute or unmute the selected voice.
Cycle the step under the cursor: on, accent, off.
Adjust the highlighted Level, Tune or Decay.
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Select it. Its light flashes when it plays.
Cycle on, accent, off and move the cursor there.
Same as K2, K3 and K4.

sections.title: Audio
sections.text: Mono output peaking near −7 dBFS. Steps keep sample-accurate time on the audio thread. Route sound and set its level in Menu. In Preview, enable Listen to preview first.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Patterns, tempo, swing, mutes and voice settings save automatically. Reopening keeps them and starts stopped.
